_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: kind: config — declarative SMS reminder channel for bookings. Adds one BookingSmsReminderChannel schema (provider config via openconnector, message template with {{variables}}, active → inactive → archived lifecycle per ADR-031, delivery scheduling, retry config, dispatch via OR notification engine per ADR-022) plus two seed channels (MessageBird active, Twilio inactive). No PHP SMS service class — dispatch and rendering are declarative (x-openregister-calculations / x-openregister-notifications). Provider credentials live in the openconnector connector referenced by providerConfig.connectorId, never in this register.

BookingSmsReminderChannel.title: SMS-herinneringskanaal
BookingSmsReminderChannel.description: Configurable SMS reminder channel for booking reminders (REQ-SMS-001). Selects an SMS provider (messagebird, twilio, or a custom openconnector connector), carries a ≤160-char message template with {{variables}}, an active → inactive → archived lifecycle (REQ-SMS-006/007), delivery timing (sendMinutesBefore) and retry config. SMS dispatch is consumed from OpenRegister's notification engine (ADR-022); message rendering and phone/length validation are declarative calculations (ADR-031). Provider API credentials are stored in the referenced openconnector connector (REQ-SMS-013), never in this register.

name.description: Human-readable channel name shown in the admin list (REQ-SMS-001).
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state (REQ-SMS-006/007). active = SMS enabled and dispatched; inactive = paused; archived = retired for audit, cannot be reactivated.
status.title: Status

provider.description: SMS provider (REQ-SMS-002). messagebird / twilio map to built-in openconnector connectors; custom uses an operator-supplied connector.
provider.title: Provider

providerConfig.description: Provider configuration (REQ-SMS-013). Holds the openconnector connector id; API credentials are stored encrypted inside that connector, not here. Sensitive values are never returned to or logged by Shillinq.

connectorId.description: Slug/id of the openconnector connector that holds the provider API credentials (encrypted, centralized).
connectorId.title: Connector ID

accountReference.description: Non-secret provider account reference (e.g. originator pool id). Never an API key.
accountReference.title: Account Reference

providerConfig.title: Provider Config

messageTemplate.description: SMS message text with {{variables}} (REQ-SMS-003/009). Constrained to ≤160 characters (single SMS). Allowed variables: customerName, bookingRef, bookingDate, bookingTime, bookingLocation, organizationName, bookingUrl.
messageTemplate.example: Hallo {{customerName}}, herinnering: uw boeking op {{bookingDate}} om {{bookingTime}}. Ref: {{bookingRef}}
messageTemplate.title: Message Template

sendMinutesBefore.description: Minutes before booking start to dispatch the reminder (REQ-SMS-005). 1440 = 24h. OR's notification engine schedules dispatch at bookingStart - sendMinutesBefore (±15 min tolerance).
sendMinutesBefore.title: Send Minutes Before

fallbackPhoneNumber.description: Default E.164/NL phone number used when the booking contact has none (REQ-SMS-004/012). Validated against E.164 + NL rules (+31… or 06…).
fallbackPhoneNumber.title: Fallback Phone Number

senderId.description: Sender ID/name shown to the recipient (REQ-SMS-011). Provider-dependent; MessageBird and Twilio cap alphanumeric sender IDs at 11 characters.
senderId.title: Sender ID

phoneNumberFormat.description: Locale phone format applied when normalizing recipient numbers (REQ-SMS-004).
phoneNumberFormat.title: Phone Number Format

retryCount.description: Number of delivery retry attempts on transient failure (REQ-SMS-008). Executed by OR's notification engine.
retryCount.title: Retry Count

logSmsCost.description: When true, each dispatch logs timestamp, provider, masked phone, message length and cost (if the provider returns it) for future billing (REQ-SMS-019).
logSmsCost.title: Log SMS Cost

respectOptOut.description: When true (default), a recipient who has opted out of SMS reminders (contact-level smsOptOut flag, resolved at dispatch time) is skipped and no message is sent (REQ-SMS-021). Phone numbers are personal data (GDPR); honouring opt-out is mandatory unless an operator explicitly disables it for transactional-only channels.
respectOptOut.title: Respect Opt Out

activatedAt.description: When the channel was first activated (set on first transition into active).
activatedAt.title: Activated At

active.label: Actief
active.description: SMS reminders are enabled and dispatched from this channel.

inactive.label: Inactief
inactive.description: SMS reminders are paused; no dispatch occurs. Can be re-activated.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Channel retired. Removed from the active list; history retained for audit. Cannot be reactivated (REQ-SMS-007).

activate.label: Kanaal activeren
activate.description: Resume dispatch (REQ-SMS-006). Stamps activatedAt on first activation.

renderedPreview.expression: renderTemplate(@self.messageTemplate, {customerName: 'Jan Jansen', bookingRef: 'BK001', bookingDate: '21 mei', bookingTime: '14:30', bookingLocation: 'Kantoor Amsterdam', organizationName: 'Example BV', bookingUrl: 'https://example.nl/b/ABC'})
renderedPreview.description: Preview of the SMS rendered with sample variable values (REQ-SMS-009). {{variable}} placeholders are substituted; undefined variables render as empty string; bookingLocation truncated >30 chars and organizationName >20 chars with an ellipsis (REQ-SMS-010).

renderedPreviewLength.description: Character count of the rendered preview (REQ-SMS-003). Used by the admin UI to warn when a real send could exceed 160 characters.

fallbackPhoneValid.description: Whether the fallback phone number is a valid E.164/NL number (REQ-SMS-004). Empty/null is treated as valid (number is optional).

onBookingReminderDue.description: Declarative SMS dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (ADR-022, REQ-SMS-005/008/018/021). When a booking.reminder-due event fires, active channels render their template with booking variables and dispatch via the referenced openconnector connector — unless the recipient has opted out (skipWhen, respected when respectOptOut is true). Retries on transient provider error per retryCount/retryIntervalSeconds; failures are logged with a masked phone number. The pure-logic gating/rendering/normalization is implemented in Shillinq's SmsReminderDispatcher helper (provider-adapter interface), keeping the orchestration unit-tested while live dispatch stays in OR's engine.

x-openregister-rbac.description: Channel management is restricted to the sms-channel-administrator role (full CRUD) and booking-administrator (read/update); auditors read-only (REQ-SMS-020). Permission slugs map onto OR CRUD permissions. Providers credentials are never readable through this schema (they live in openconnector).
